title.narrative: Mine Action Support to the Humanitarian Response in Northern Ethiopia

description.narrative: The project aims to enable the safe mobility of at-risk populations and humanitarians operating in the northern provinces, and support the safe delivery of humanitarian aid, especially food, thereby reducing risk of injury and death. It will also enable the documentation of the scope and scale of contamination. Explosive Ordnance Awareness teams will gather evidence to quantify the level and type of contamination and inform a further plan of action, budget and timeline for clearance based on the future availability of clearance operators. Teams will be deployed to conduct surveys in 35 prioritized, conflict-affected woredas (districts) in Tigray, and Afar in Ethiopia
